paragraphs: Before entering, two workers cross-check protective suits and respirators, follow the designated route into the contaminated zone, and seal samples. They use negative-pressure equipment to extract spills, drum and label waste, then follow washing and doffing procedures on exit and check each item. The shift ends only after disposal forms are complete.

In short: remove hazardous substances according to procedure. Workers put on and remove protection, package and transport hazardous waste, handle spills and contamination, monitor air and residues, operate decontamination equipment, and complete disposal and transfer forms.

AI will not replace hazardous materials removal workers, but it will reshape their workflow.
